_comment: Hand-maintained facts that are not in a data file. The dashboard shows only what runs: 'pipeline' = the two lanes of the Airflow DAG, 'stack' = the services and libraries in use, 'latest_dag_run' = the latest normal scheduled run (evidence in reports/live/evidence/). Everything else is read from the report tables, reports/ and git.

steps.detail: EIA API: daily Henry Hub gas and WTI crude

steps.detail: 8 data-quality rules and a report per run

steps.name: Paper trade
steps.detail: Champion trades each new EIA day

stack.name: Docker Compose
stack.role: Runs every service from one file

latest_dag_run.note: The champion was healthy, so the retraining branch was skipped.

limitations: One test period of 414 days, driven largely by two weather-related price spikes.
Trading is simulated at the daily spot price with a 0.1 % cost; no spreads or market impact.
Paper trading began on 7 July 2026, too recently to confirm the champion beats Buy & Hold.
